name: useWifi7MLO
summary: Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) Multi-Link Operation links: band, channel, RSSI, link speeds and state.
plain: Lists the Wi-Fi 7 multi-link operation links of the connected access point with band, channel, signal and link speeds, and whether this phone is associated to more than one of them. Values the platform reports as unknown are null.
description: Reads WifiInfo.getAffiliatedMloLinks() (all links of the access point multi-link device) and getAssociatedMloLinks() (the links this station is associated to), Android 14+ (API 34+). Each link carries band (MloLink.getBand(): 2.4GHz, 5GHz, 6GHz, 60GHz or null), channel, rssi, txLinkSpeedMbps and rxLinkSpeedMbps (null when the platform reports an unknown value) and state (MloLink.getState(): unassociated, idle, active, or invalid). The platform exposes no per-link channel width. isMloActive is true when the station is associated to more than one link. aggregateSpeedMbps is the sum of txLinkSpeedMbps (transmit direction only) over the associated links, not a PHY capacity figure; it is null when not multi-link or when no link reported a speed. Reports inactive with an empty links array when the connected access point is not a multi-link device.

returns.name: isSupported
returns.desc: Whether this app could query MLO links (Android 14+ and the query did not throw). Not a hardware capability flag.

returns.name: isMloActive
returns.desc: Whether the station is associated to more than one link.

returns.name: links
returns.desc: Links of the access point multi-link device with band, channel, RSSI and link speeds; each link's state says whether this station is associated to it.

returns.name: aggregateSpeedMbps
returns.desc: Sum of txLinkSpeedMbps over the associated links (transmit direction only), or null when not multi-link or no link reported a speed.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Error message if Wi-Fi link inspection failed.

returns.name: refresh
returns.desc: Queries the Wi-Fi subsystem for updated link state.

actions.name: refresh()
actions.desc: Requests an updated reading of affiliated Wi-Fi 7 links.

agentNote: Available on Android 14+ (API 34+). Links appear only while connected to a Wi-Fi 7 multi-link access point. rssi and link speeds are null when the platform reports them as unknown.
